chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: Lexington, Louisville and Cincinnati: the recording trip
summary: The Roseland Ballroom in Lexington, the Brown Hotel, and then Cincinnati where they record.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: These must have been during the time that you were in Louisville.
We were in Lexington and Louisville--
In Lexington, that was the Roseland or--
And you played at the Brown Hotel too, didn't you?
We played at the Brown in Louisville.
Louisville, right; the other one was Lexington. Then from there is when you went to the Graystone in Cincinnati. That must have been when you got to make the records.
Yeah, we went down and made the record; right.
Mouse would have been in the band at that time; Mouse is pretty sure that he's in.
He was. This is the list right here.
